prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original 2D side-view battle-stage backdrop for a cozy painted cat hero game, no characters. Create one finished empty cafe interior painting, wide 2:1 composition, ideally 2048 by 1024. Orthographic side view, camera square to the back wall, a gentle shallow visible floor, no dramatic perspective. Three large evenly spaced arched dark-wood windows across the upper 60 percent, narrow honey-plaster wall columns between them, muted blue-sage moonlit hedges and a few tiny stars outside. Window sills around 60 percent image height. Small cream ceramic cups and modest herb pots rest only on the sills; two warm shaded hanging lanterns on the narrow columns. Cozy dark walnut wainscot just below the windows. The lower 30 percent is a broad empty honey-brown wooden floor for characters to stand, mostly horizontal soft plank seams, low contrast faded woven oval rug near center. No furniture, counter, tables or objects projecting into the battle floor. Style: softly painted storybook concept art, textured gouache and subtle oil-like brushwork, warm fluffy gentle feeling, tactile wood grain and imperfect plaster, restrained detailed edges, soft amber lantern bloom and cool moonlight. Palette: honey #efbd73, cream #fff0ca, muted sage #a9c49a, warm plaster #bd9470, walnut #755144, ink-plum #49333a, night-blue #42545c. Balance quiet broad value shapes with painterly detail around the upper windows. Keep the lower central and side fighting areas uncluttered and softly mid-toned so cats and purple-red monsters will read clearly. The image fills the frame edge to edge without borders or margins. Absolutely no people, cats, creatures, enemies, silhouettes of characters, text, lettering, symbols, user interface or watermark. No neon, science-fiction, photographic rendering, 3D render, vector-flat geometry, glowing outlines or hard gradients. This must be original artwork from these words alone, not a recreation of another game's art.
purpose: Original empty cafe placeholder backdrop. No generated character art.
